merchant/31427.htm.text: Amulet Seller Urgal: May the glorious eternal flame shine upon you! Last night I dreamt of that unquenchable flame! I took it as a sign that I would soon meet someone whose heart burned with ambition, and here you are! Am I glad to see you, brother!
